chunks: The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.
Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar, from Hammad ibn Shu'ayb, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: The pronouncement of Allahu Akbar in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: The deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are recited in the prayer over the deceased according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling that the funeral prayer over the deceased includes five takbirs. It is a concise fiqh report from Imam Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام transmitted through a sanad in al-Istibsar.
